description: The model's active articles not yet on Amazon become ONE listing with variations — Amazon's "variation family"; call it a model with variations when talking to the user: a parent whose SKU is the model's code (no price, no quantity) and a child listing per article, varying by colour and/or size — the theme is chosen from what the Amazon product type declares. Every listing is first validated by Amazon (VALIDATION_PREVIEW); only when ALL of them would be accepted is the family created — a REAL publication: the parent first, then each child with its price and quantity. Run check_amazon_variation_family first. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing, and while listing creation is not armed on the Amazon connection. Returns the same report with statuses created, failed, notAttempted or notChecked; each child's offer names the price, currency, quantity and fulfilment it is submitted with (quantityOmitted says why no quantity goes out), and progress says what is left (createdNow, alreadyOnAmazon, remaining, notReached) and the one next step: done, callAgain, fixAndRetry, fixGaps or publish. A model of about 80 articles is meant to finish in one call; a bigger one, or a slow Amazon, takes more: notChecked and notAttempted both mean the run ran out of time, so call again — a dry run an article passed is kept for an hour while its data stays the same, created articles are skipped (nothing is submitted twice), the parent and the theme stay, and the rest continue. created means Amazon ACCEPTED the child for processing, not that it is live: Amazon finishes asynchronously, so check the outcome with inspect_amazon_listings and never tell the user the family is live from this result alone. The result echoes the workspace.

marketplaceId.description: One Amazon store by its id. Omit for the main store; for a write with several stores open it is required. Each store holds its own family, in its own language.

modelId.description: A product model id (the model a product's modelId points at; get_product shows it).

name: publish_amazon_variation_family
title: Publish a model with variations on Amazon
